content: Form validation, edge case, and negative testing best practices for AI QA agents: must explicitly test negative flows and invalid inputs such as out of range values, wrong types, and empty or incomplete fields, verify graceful error handling with informative messages instead of crashes. Boundary value analysis using min, max, zero, negative, and over limit values catches a disproportionate number of bugs. Prefer goal or behavior based validation over exact string assertions for open ended agent outputs. AI native platforms increasingly discover edge cases autonomously by analyzing UI plus inferred business logic rather than only running pre scripted cases.
